title: A generation can silently drop its style LoRAs and still look like a success
description: Found while diagnosing the first GPU smoke matrix, 2026-08-08. ComfyUI validates a prompt PER OUTPUT NODE: when one output fails validation it logs 'Failed to validate prompt for output N' + 'Output will be ignored' and executes the REST of the graph. So a graph whose style-LoRA branch is invalid still renders from a sibling output, returns media, and reads as a complete success - with none of the requested styles applied. Observed live on the Pod: krea2-nsfw ops PASSED the smoke while the Pod log carried value_not_in_list for every one of krea2_rainywindow, krea2_kidsdrawing, krea2_dotmatrix, krea2_darkbrush, krea2_neondrip, KREA_MIDJ_1, krea2_sunsetblur, krea2_softwatercolor, krea2_retroanime and krea2_vintagetarot. Same shape on chroma and flux2-klein. NOTE the specific trigger there was the smoke runner skipping comfyController 3b's separator heal (fixed, MPI-467) - but the SILENCE is the real defect and is independent of that cause: ANY reason a LoRA value misses the enum (a renamed file, a dep that failed to install, a new subfoldered LoRA, a partial uninstall) produces a picture with no styles and no error. The user sees a normal image and no toast. Nothing app-side reads the validation errors: the wrapper returns them in the /prompt response body, and the app's own MPI-229 handling only covers a LoRA it already knows is absent. WHERE TO LOOK: comfyController's prompt dispatch + the wrapper's /wrapper/prompt passthrough, which already surfaces comfy_status/comfy_body on a hard 400. ACCEPTANCE: a run whose style-LoRA node fails validation must surface it to the user (toast or a failed generation), and it must be impossible to receive an unstyled image reported as a styled success. Guard it with a test that feeds a graph with one invalid lora value and asserts the run does not report plain success.
